results.content:
## General Register Office

Please note that GRO does not deal with passports. For passport complaints, please see the information above.

If you have a complaint or enquiry about our service, please contact our customer contact centre by using our online enquiry form, by phone or in writing.

### Online

If your complaint relates to a certificate which you have ordered from GRO, you can use our certificate service order enquiries form to send us a message.

When you submit this form, it will generate an email to us with the details you have supplied.

### By phone

0300 123 1837 (+44 300 123 1837 if you are calling from overseas)

Monday to Friday: 8am to 6pm

Saturday: 9am to 1pm [...] ## What you can expect from us

We aim to provide a high standard of customer service in all our dealings with customers. You can expect:

 staff to be polite, helpful and professional
 passports to be issued in line with our published standards
 details on your passport to be correct and your supporting documents to be returned promptly
 registration certificates to be issued in line with our published standards from the General Register Office (GRO)
 special provisions and services for people with disabilities
 clear and helpful explanations from our staff if you are denied a British passport because of citizenship or on other grounds

The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company. The first one suggested to have another try as I said "no weeds die after 2 days"; One week, 85% of the lawns (front and back) were burned and turn brown; another ambassador deflected with " difficult to see any damages" ; then a new ambassador started with weather excuses; then someone offered a refund of the defective product; After being rejected, another ambassador offered grass seed/fertilizer for next spring. If the weeds and/or lawn had gone into a dormant state because of this, then it is also recommended not to apply any products until the lawn is growing REMOVEDhelp get your lawn back on track, I am offering a refund of one (1) 2.8 kg bag of Scotts grass seed and a 4.7kg of Scotts starter fertilizer. Thank you for reviewing my case and the seed/fertilizer offerI'll accept the 2.8 kg Scotts grass seed and 4.7 kg starter fertilizer as a partial goodwill gesture (please process via Amazon credit to REMOVEDHowever, this does not address the core issue: severe, unintended damage to my healthy, actively growing lawn caused by your Ortho Killex Lawn Weed Control Ready-to-Spray, applied exactly as directed. After careful review, I must Reject Business Response because: the company's reply does not adequately address the core issues in my complaint, continues to deflect responsibility onto unrelated environmental factors, and fails to provide fair compensation for the damage caused by their defective product, Killex. Dear REMOVED(Brand Ambassador), Scotts Miracle-Gro REMOVEDand Investor Relations Team,(CC: REMOVEDCanada Customer Care as the retailer where I purchased the Ortho Killex product in Medicine Hat, AB, I'm including you for transparency on this supplier-related damage issue. I then provided evidence of written letters from friends stating similar issues of Scott’s weed and feed killing their lawn, photos showing that all other plants and flowers in my yard are thriving so the dead sod can’t be due to a drought, plus I live in Florida which is not experiencing any drought conditions and proof that I properly applied the product with a Scott’s applicator machine.
